Around 2002

blocks.source: 物語
blocks.translation: Story

blocks.source: となると、前作プレイヤーは既に結末を知っているため、エンディングへの期待感が薄れてしまうのは仕方ないこと。とはいえ、最後の展開には一捻りを加えており見所もある。個人的には「内容が分かりきっているからつまらない」ということにはならずに済んだ。
blocks.translation: That means players of the previous game already know how it ends, so it is unavoidable that their anticipation for the ending is diminished. Even so, the final developments include a twist, making them worth seeing. Personally, I was glad it did not simply become a case of “It’s boring because you already know what happens.”

blocks.source: 前作は超絶お使いゲーだったけれど、今回はそれなりに改善されている。確かにお使いイベントは多いけれど、前作並みの酷いタライ回しはなし。印象に残るサブキャラも増えて１イベントの密度が濃くなっている。何よりも、ゲームシステムが練られていることが大きい。
blocks.translation: The previous game was an absolutely excessive fetch-quest simulator, but this one has been improved to a reasonable degree. There are certainly many fetch quests, but none of the horrendous runaround found in the previous game. There are also more memorable supporting characters, giving each event greater substance. Above all, the refined game system makes a major difference.

blocks.source: 急展開な強制結婚イベントがあるせいで、主人公マキシムにはちょっと感情移入しづらかった。前作プレイヤーには予想できる事とはいえ、幼馴染キャラに関心を寄せず、途中出場のメインヒロインに高速でなびく彼に、置いてけぼりを喰らったプレイヤーも多いはず。
blocks.translation: The protagonist, Maxim, was somewhat difficult to empathize with because of the sudden forced-marriage event. Although players of the previous game could predict it, many players must have felt left behind when he quickly fell for the main heroine who appears midway through the story, without showing any interest in his childhood friend.

blocks.source: 同じく結婚イベントがあるＤＱ５だと、プレイヤーに一応の選択肢を掲示することで、置いてけぼり感を抑えているのだけど、そういうのはなし。
blocks.translation: In Dragon Quest V, which also has a marriage event, the sense of being left behind is softened by at least presenting the player with a choice, but there is nothing like that here.

blocks.source: システム／バランス
blocks.translation: Systems / Balance

blocks.source: 戦闘
blocks.translation: Battle

blocks.source: 前作とは変わって、普通のターン制の戦闘になったが、別の点で既存のRPGとは差別化を行なっている。特徴的なのはＩＰを消費して装備品固有の技を放つシステム。ＩＰを溜めるには、敵の攻撃を受ける必要がある。ＦＦ７のリミット技に似ているが、もちろんこちらが先発。
blocks.translation: Unlike the previous game, battles are now ordinary turn-based affairs, but the game differentiates itself from existing RPGs in other ways. The most distinctive feature is a system that consumes IP to unleash techniques unique to equipment. To build up IP, you have to take attacks from enemies. It resembles Final Fantasy VII’s Limit techniques, but of course, this game came first.

blocks.source: 難易度はやや低めで、テンポ良く進む。ＩＰ技は強力なので、うまく使いこなせば、ボス戦も楽勝できる。
blocks.translation: The difficulty is somewhat low, and the game moves along at a good pace. IP techniques are powerful, so if you master their use, even boss battles can be won with ease.

blocks.source: ストーリー上の強制敗北戦闘があるけれど、勝利することで、その時点では強力な武器を得ることができるというヘビーユーザー向けの要素も。
blocks.translation: There are story battles that you are forced to lose, but winning them lets you obtain powerful weapons for that point in the game—an element aimed at hardcore players.

blocks.source: ダンジョン
blocks.translation: Dungeons

blocks.source: 戦闘だけでなく、ダンジョンも謎解き要素が豊富に。『ゼルダの伝説』の様に弓や爆弾などの道具を駆使して、謎を解く必要がある。というか、フックショットまである辺りはもろにゼルダ。面倒だったり難しかったりする仕掛けはほどほどでバランスも良好。ただし、本編クリアと関係無いパズルには難しいものも。
blocks.translation: Dungeons, not just battles, are packed with puzzle-solving elements. As in The Legend of Zelda, you need to use tools such as bows and bombs to solve puzzles. In fact, the presence of even a Hookshot makes the Zelda influence unmistakable. The number of tedious or difficult mechanisms is kept reasonable, and the balance is good. However, some puzzles unrelated to clearing the main story are quite difficult.

blocks.source: 前作はランダムエンカウントだったが、今回はシンボルエンカウント制を採用。前作の高いエンカウント率と比較すると、戦闘の頻度は抑えられている。（※フィールドはランダムエンカウントのまま）こちらが動くとモンスターも動くという『トルネコの大冒険』や『風来のシレン』であったようなシステム。弓矢で敵の動きを止めて戦闘を避けることもできる。
blocks.translation: The previous game used random encounters, but this one adopts a visible enemy encounter system. Compared with the previous game’s high encounter rate, battles occur less frequently. (※The field areas still use random encounters.) It is a system like those seen in Mystery Dungeon: Shiren the Wanderer and Torneko’s Great Adventure, where monsters move whenever you do. You can also stop enemies with arrows and avoid battles.

blocks.source: 難易度は低めでサクサク進む。手応えを求める人にはサブイベントとして『いにしえの洞窟』というランダム生成ダンジョンがある。洞窟に入るとレベル１から開始となるので、なかなか難しい。
blocks.translation: The difficulty is low, and the game progresses smoothly. For those looking for a challenge, there is a randomly generated dungeon called “Ancient Cave” as a side quest. Since entering the cave resets you to level 1, it is quite difficult.

blocks.source: 色んな作品のいいとこ取りが多いが、うまくまとまっており完成度は高い。
blocks.translation: Although it borrows many of the best elements from various works, they are put together skillfully, resulting in a highly polished game.

blocks.source: 快適性
blocks.translation: Comfort

blocks.source: 戦闘テンポはまずまずで、レスポンスも良好。ただし、ＩＰ関連の表示が分かり辛いのは気になった。
blocks.translation: The battle tempo is decent, and the response is good. However, I found the IP-related displays difficult to understand.

blocks.source: メニューのトップ画面でＭＰは表示されるのにＩＰは表示されない。確認には、個別のステータス画面を見る必要がある。
blocks.translation: MP is displayed on the menu’s top screen, but IP is not. To check it, you have to open each individual status screen.

blocks.source: 装備品が保有するＩＰ技を確認するには、カーソルを合わせて、いちいちＸボタンを押す必要がある。
blocks.translation: To check the IP techniques possessed by a piece of equipment, you have to move the cursor over it and press the X button every single time.

blocks.source: ＩＰは１００％まで保有できるが、技がどれだけのＩＰを消耗するかは、使ってみないと分からない。
blocks.translation: You can hold up to 100% IP, but you cannot tell how much IP a technique consumes until you try using it.

blocks.source: どうも、後から付け加えた要素なのか、ＭＰと比較すると、ＩＰの存在を考慮したインターフェースになってないような……。
blocks.translation: Perhaps it was added later, but compared with MP, the interface does not seem to take the existence of IP into account……

blocks.source: 美術
blocks.translation: Art

blocks.source: ＳＦＣ後期のＲＰＧらしい美麗なドット絵。ただ、敵は小さくなったので迫力は減少したところも。キャラグラは可愛いけど、主人公の髪型はリーゼント。
blocks.translation: Beautiful pixel art typical of a late-SFC-era RPG. However, the enemies have become smaller, which has reduced their impact in some places. The character designs are cute, but the protagonist has a pompadour.

blocks.source: 音楽
blocks.translation: Music

blocks.source: 前作のアレンジになっているラストダンジョン曲が随分と格好良くなっている。３曲ある戦闘曲はどれも良曲で、戦闘を盛り上げる。ラスボスに専用曲がないのだけが、ちょっと残念。
blocks.translation: The last-dungeon theme, which is an arrangement of a song from the previous game, has become considerably cooler. All three battle themes are excellent and heighten the excitement of battles. It is just a little disappointing that the final boss has no dedicated theme.

blocks.source: 余談だけど、ラストバトル後のシーンで流れる某曲がスパロボＫに丸パクりされていたのには驚愕した。なんてこったい……。
blocks.translation: As an aside, I was shocked to discover that a certain song played in the scene after the final battle was blatantly copied in Super Robot Wars K. Good grief……

blocks.source: まとめ
blocks.translation: Conclusion

blocks.source: この作品は、ＳＦＣの隠れた良作としては真っ先に挙げられるタイトル。
blocks.translation: This is one of the first titles that comes to mind as an overlooked SFC gem.

blocks.source: 自分の経験上、マイナーながら良作と呼ばれるような作品をやると、意外と粗が目につくことが多い。
blocks.translation: In my experience, when you play a relatively obscure game regarded as a hidden gem, its rough edges often become surprisingly noticeable.

blocks.source: その中では、この作品はやや小作りながらも『シナリオ』『システム』『快適性』『音楽』などなど。全体的な水準が高く、他の一流所のＲＰＧと比べても引けを取らない。
blocks.translation: Among such games, this one is somewhat modest in scope, but it excels in areas such as its “scenario,” “system,” “comfort,” and “music.” Its overall quality is high, and it compares favorably with other first-rate RPGs.

blocks.source: 惜しいのは、前作の完成度がこれに比較できるレベルではない上に、やたら長いこと。シャドウハーツ１，２もそうだけど、話の繋がった続編を楽しむためには、微妙な前作をクリアしなければならないというのは辛い。
blocks.translation: The unfortunate part is that the previous game is nowhere near this one’s level of polish, yet is extremely long. Shadow Hearts 1 and 2 are similar, but it is tough having to clear a mediocre predecessor in order to enjoy a connected sequel.

blocks.source: もっとも、この作品に付いては、時代設定としては１よりも前の話なので、先にこちらをやっても支障ないかも……。
blocks.translation: That said, this game takes place earlier than the first one chronologically, so playing it first may not cause any problems……

blocks.source: ２０１０年に『エストポリス』としてＤＳでリメイクされた模様。なぜか、ＡＲＰＧ形式になっておりシステム的には別物らしい。主にゲームシステムの完成度で評判になった作品なのに、そこを変えたら誰得状態にしかならない気もするのだけど……。
blocks.translation: Apparently, it was remade for the DS in 2010 as “Estpolis.” For some reason, it was turned into an action RPG, making it a completely different game in terms of its systems. This title was primarily praised for the polish of its game system, so changing that seems like it could only result in a situation where nobody benefits……
